text: Technical assistance for the performative lecture on performative lecture that Max Azemar gives to the students taking the final-degree-project course at Escola Massana.

The lecture uses school cardboard as a support instead of the classic power point and, among other performative actions, the speaker has the script written on his body, a firecracker goes off in the middle of the talk, subway surfers is played to boost attention, and the audience has the power to interrupt the session at any moment with a noisy horn.
